# Chris Johnson

> Senior Network Optimization Engineer with 15+ years designing and optimizing large-scale backbone and carrier networks. Based in Denver, CO. Currently at Uniti Group Inc., focused on cost optimization, network consolidation, and infrastructure modernization. Specialties include BGP, MPLS, DWDM, SD-WAN, and carrier WAN at scale.

## Current Role

Senior Network Optimization Engineer at Uniti Group Inc. (May 2022 to present), remote from Denver, CO. Prior: Senior Planning Engineer and Network Planning Engineer at Lumen Technologies (2012 to 2022), and Network Planning Engineer at Windstream Communications (2010 to 2012).

## Selected Impact

- $261K in monthly recurring costs eliminated in 2025 through 7 site exits and 3 consolidations (57 circuits decommissioned, 634 groomed, zero customer-impacting events).
- Zero planned downtime during the Truth or Consequences, NM node insert, protecting broadband service to the city during an Albuquerque consolidation.
- 83% reduction in per-config time via a router configuration template tool adopted by the full engineering team.
- $2M+ annual savings delivered at Uniti through contract renegotiation, vendor management, and network consolidation.
